meta.name: architecture-blueprint-generator
meta.description: Comprehensive project architecture blueprint generator that analyzes codebases to create detailed architectural documentation. Automatically detects technology stacks and architectural patterns, generates visual diagrams, documents implementation patterns, and provides extensible blueprints for maintaining architectural consistency and guiding new development.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析代码库自动生成架构蓝图与文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在代码基础上快速生成清晰的架构文档和可视化图表。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze codebases to auto-generate architecture blueprints and docs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly generate clear architecture docs and diagrams from existing code.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会分析你提供的代码库，自动检测技术栈和架构模式，生成详细的架构文档，包括架构图、组件说明、实现模式等。
howto.when: 当你提供代码库或项目结构，并要求生成架构蓝图或文档时触发。

say.text: 分析这个项目的架构，生成蓝图文档。
say.note: Claude 会扫描目录并输出架构文档。

say.text: 帮我画出这个代码库的组件图。
say.note: Claude 将生成 C4/UML 等图表。

howto.what_en: When activated, Claude analyzes your codebase, auto-detects tech stacks and architectural patterns, and generates detailed architecture documentation including diagrams, component descriptions, and implementation patterns.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide a codebase or project structure and request architecture blueprint or documentation.

say_en.text: Analyze this project's architecture and generate a blueprint.
say_en.note: Claude scans and outputs architecture doc.

say_en.text: Draw component diagrams for this codebase.
